query:
WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT id, provider
                    FROM email_links
                    WHERE id > $1
                    ORDER BY id
                    LIMIT $2
                )
                SELECT
                    count(*) AS "scanned!",
                    COALESCE(array_agg(id ORDER BY id)
                        FILTER (WHERE provider IS DISTINCT FROM 'OUTLOOK'), '{}'::uuid[]) AS "links!",
                    (
                        SELECT id
                        FROM page
                        ORDER BY id DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                    ) AS last_id
                FROM page
